what: When a hand is over the card, a 1px grid lights up over the photo at .15 and flows endlessly two cells at a time in 1.2s from the corner the hand entered toward the opposite one, while the photo approaches to 1.1x in 1.6s and fades to .8
note: Not applied on touch devices (the original has interaction only too)
